title: Research: compose a 92-helper P104 three-target correction
body:
## Summary

One dirty helper can acquire X6, X1 and X0 at different chronological cuts and restore its original value afterward. Replacing only PR2460’s Y2-exclusive correction group reduces its three-target logical construction from 94 to 92 new helper lifetimes.

This is a finite construction, an exact local cost comparison, and a sharp lower bound for one isolated correction group. No new κ. The selected conditional κ remains 836330098538459/500000000000000000.

## Exact result

The construction completes Y0, Y1 and Y2 as yt + xt. The other 101 targets retain their original G/2 updates. All original X inputs and all original/new dirty helper inputs are restored in their prescribed final frames. All 4,058 original events and the other six correction groups are retained unchanged.

| Added quantity | PR2460 literal | Initial-line direct-delivery control | New construction |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Helper lifetimes | 94 | 94 | 92 |
| Logical ADDs | 532 | 521 | 517 |
| Nested transports | 287 | 287 | 283 |
| Dimension-gap rank mass | 846 | 846 | 828 |
| Source reads, including cleanup | 180 | 180 | 180 |

The direct-delivery control separates an ordinary 11-ADD simplification from the late-acquisition mechanism. Relative to that control, late acquisition saves two lifetimes, four ADDs, four transports and 18 rank units.

The complete new word has 4,858 events, 372 independent inputs and 138,384 endpoint coefficients. Its added transport profile is:

146 H1 + 38 H2 + 7 H3 + H4 + 8 H5 + 40 H6 + 43 H7.

The shared helper captures X6 at original cut 0, X1 at cut 669 and X0 at cut 842, each with coefficient -1/2. Every delivery, dirty compensation, source access, transport and cleanup is included.

For the isolated twelve-source Y2-exclusive group, ten helper lifetimes are necessary and sufficient. The proof uses ten sources whose available acquisition frames are pairwise incomparable: 45 source pairs and 84 frame pairs. It permits internal relays, repeated reads and input-independent rational coefficients, under the stated X-only monotone-frame contract. With ZERO-to-FULL exits, the branch’s minimum dimension-gap rank mass is 90.

This is not an unrestricted 92-helper optimum.

## Relationship to predecessor and concurrent work

PR2460 supplies the three-target architecture and six retained groups. This contribution changes its initial-line acquisition premise for the exclusive group and verifies the complete composition.

The exact exclusive source set is {0,1,3,6,8,11,16,19,25,28,97,99}. Only {0,1,3,6} also have later compatible frames. PR2460’s prose conflates the twelve later-compatible sources with the twelve exclusive sources; its circuit remains valid and is successfully replayed here.

Concurrent PR2496 targets Y2 alone and explicitly asks about composition with PR2460. No priority is claimed for late acquisition itself. Its three proposed paths cannot simply replace the exclusive group because the source sets differ. This package supplies the distinct three-target composition and the sharp ten-helper bound for the correct exclusive group.

Assignment seed: OS-generated 34, complex-supplier track. The deterministic search covers all 4,095 nonempty subsets over all 20 relevant contact intervals, finding 17 feasible one-helper source sets and a minimum cover of ten. Work stopped after attaining and verifying this scoped result. An initial pilot using the wrong source set was rejected and is not used.

## Reproduction and executed checks

Run:

    python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-late-y2-acquisition-s34

Expected primary result:

    PASS_P104_LATE_Y2_S34 paths=10 helpers=92 adds=517 rank_mass=828 endpoint_coefficients=138384 rejecting_controls=10 no_new_kappa

The separate checker reports an antichain of ten, 84 frame pairs and zero direct contacts. The runner finishes with PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE and outcome=completed.

Executed successfully:
- Full sparse-rational replay and complete circuit regeneration.
- Separate dense-dyadic replay with binary Gaussian elimination and independent root generation.
- Ten primary rejection controls covering compensation, capture, delivery, cleanup, signs, illegal cuts, undercharging, final frames and antichain premises.
- Four independently implemented rejection controls, plus legal-cut and equivalent-basis positive controls.
- Six subprocess evidence-integrity tests, including Git-free read-only exports, corrupt inputs, missing/altered receipts, false metadata, changes outside the claimed group and overwrite refusal.
- make selected-record-check.
- All 24 tests in test_research_onboarding.py.
- Package metadata/source-pin checks and git diff --check.
- Remote branch fetched back; its complete tree matches the tested local tree.

## Scope and remaining obligations

The lower bound isolates the exclusive group: other correction groups are fixed and inaccessible, original sources are immutable, helper frames only increase, and original helper/target values cannot be read.

The original common-chart and eight owned private-copy contracts are inherited. Native phase/scalar/address lowering of the added word, global owner/idle/residual costs, remaining 101 corrections, physical precision/tape, all-size compilation and analytical transfer remain unresolved.

No full selected-frontier cold replay, hosted CI, proof-assistant verification or independent human review is claimed. The two implementations were written by the same AI-assisted contributor.

Public HTML/Git overlap checks can miss hidden comments and unpublished work. No selected record, upstream file or frozen predecessor was modified.
